name: wisp-packs
description: House packs: plain markdown on how the owner builds (rust-house, ts-house), applied when a repo's AGENTS.md has a Packs: line or on request. Commands: load, list, suggest.

interface.shortDescription: Apply house packs for Rust and TypeScript work.
interface.longDescription: Short markdown packs on how the owner builds: deviations from model defaults, the checks that prove them and a file to imitate. A repo opts in with a Packs: line in AGENTS.md; load applies packs, list shows them, suggest recommends them.
defaultPrompt: Load the rust-house pack and follow it for this task.
